definitions.gloss: main occupation, primary business, day job
definitions.explanation: One's principal line of work or core business activity, as distinguished from side jobs, hobbies, or secondary ventures.

examples.japanese: {本業|ほんぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧です。
examples.english: My main job is as an office worker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{本業|ほんぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支障|ししょう}→支障：12934_shishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My side job is so busy that it's interfering with my main work.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本業|ほんぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}{業|ぎょう}→製造業：14148_seizougyou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げている→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: That company is making more profit from its real estate business than from its core manufacturing operations.

notes:
USAGE:
Contrasts with ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧ (side job) and is increasingly relevant in modern Japan as more workers take on multiple jobs. Can refer to an individual's primary occupation or a company's core business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本業|ほんぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専念|せんねん}する→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧: to focus on one's main job
- {本業|ほんぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支障|ししょう}→支障：12934_shishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to interfere with one's main work
- {本業|ほんぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かたわら: alongside one's main job

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧: side job, side business
- ⟦{生業|なりわい}→生業：13523_nariwai⟧: livelihood, means of living (more literary)
- ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧: occupation, profession (general term)
